task:
Make the committed conformance suite test/supabase-members-router.test.ts pass. It is the SPEC and you CANNOT edit it (outside your write scope). Implement the membership-invitations route from docs/plans/2026-07-16-supabase-membership-provisioning.md Section 3. Edit ONLY under src/supabase/ and wrangler.jsonc.

Build a NEW Gatekeeper-owned member-write surface (independent of Supabase's internal write transport, which is deferred to Task 0):

  POST /supabase/members/:slug/invitations   body: { users: [ { email, role, project_refs? } ] }

Handler (put it in a new src/supabase/member-router.ts and mount it on supabaseApp in src/supabase/router.ts BEFORE the '/v1/*' and '/v0/*' catch-alls; mirror the existing metrics-route style - getStub, extractBearerKey, sbJsonError, extractRequestFields, breadcrumb log object emitted once via console.log(JSON.stringify(log))). Order of checks:
  1. extractBearerKey -> 401 if absent (sbJsonError(401, ...)).
  2. COARSE authorize: build a single RequestContext { action: 'supabase:members:invite', resource: `org:<slug>`, fields: extractRequestFields(req) } and call stub.authorize(keyId, '', [coarseCtx]). If not authorized -> 401 for 'Invalid API key' else 403 (reuse the authErrorStatus helper pattern already in router.ts). This rejects invalid/unauthorized keys before the body is parsed.
  3. Parse the body with parseMemberRequest (from ./member-schema). On throw -> sbJsonError(400, message).
  4. FINE authorize: buildMemberContexts('supabase:members:invite', assignments, `org:<slug>`) (from ./member-context) and call stub.authorize(keyId, '', contexts). If not authorized -> 403 (include auth.error). This is the per-assignment gate: the existing evaluatePolicy ANDs all contexts so one bad item rejects the whole batch.
  5. Rate limit: await stub.consumeSupabaseRateLimit(); on !allowed -> 429 with Retry-After (mirror managementApiHandler).
  6. Upstream write transport is NOT resolved yet -> return sbJsonError(501, 'Supabase member-write transport is not yet wired (see plan Task 0)'). Set a breadcrumb like 'supabase-members-invite-upstream-pending'.

Set distinct kebab-case breadcrumbs on each decision branch (supabase-members-invite-no-key, supabase-members-invite-authz-denied, supabase-members-invite-bad-body, supabase-members-invite-rate-limited, supabase-members-invite-upstream-pending).

wrangler.jsonc: add '/supabase/members/*' to assets.run_worker_first (otherwise the asset layer serves dashboard HTML at deploy - the route works in vitest but fails open in prod).

WORKFLOW: read test/supabase-members-router.test.ts and the existing src/supabase/router.ts metrics handler first. Then implement. Run `bunx vitest run test/supabase-members-router.test.ts` as you go.

HARD CONSTRAINTS: Edit ONLY src/supabase/** and wrangler.jsonc. Do NOT weaken/skip/delete any test. Do NOT touch scripts/api-coverage. Do NOT add a real fetch() to any Supabase endpoint - the write path returns 501 for now. Run prettier (tabs, single quotes, semicolons, width 140) so `bun run lint` passes.
